title: A Random Forest Classifier for Anomaly Detection in Laser-Powder Bed Fusion Using Optical Monitoring.
summary: RF segments anomalies in integral optical-tomography images from a Ti64 LPBF build with deliberately induced laser-power defects; the article reports 99.98% detection accuracy and 79.40% of CT defects correlated with OT anomalies. CT is the validation reference. AI role: Random-forest classifier on optical-tomography images. The article appeared in Materials (Basel, Switzerland).
